# ADMIN-D5 Categories and tags

Page spec: docs/build/2026-11-04-admin-workflow-map.md#D5

Build scope 2026-11-05 (T9): Status switch, Add on the tab row, duplicate error clears, count links to the Library, row menu without column menu on pinned columns, phone layout. Settings > Clinical settings shares the component; it persists in `state.program` [REQ SL-07] and never offers lab or simulation [REQ SC-12].

## Tasks
| Task | Entry | Steps | Finish | Landing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Add | Add a category at the right of the tab row | Type a name in the field that opens, Enter; repeat, or Cancel | Row added; the field stays open for another | This page, same tab |
| Rename | Row menu | Rename, change the name in the dialog, Save name | Every skill follows; result banner | This page, same tab |
| Deactivate | Status switch on the row | Switch off; switch on to reactivate | Row reads Inactive at once, no dialog; sorts last when the list next opens; skills keep it marked inactive | This page, same row |
